claims.text: The Neural Image Captioning (NIC) model and the Image Captioning model from the Pytorch-tutorial by Yunjey are used for evaluation.
The NIC model utilizes a CNN architecture (VGG-16) for feature extraction and LSTM for decoding.
The Pytorch-tutorial model employs a ResNet-152 architecture for encoding and LSTM for decoding.
